t: A small two-wheel teaching robot from Arduino with lots of built-in sensors.
steps: Buy the Arduino Alvik from the Arduino Store or DigiKey.
Charge the battery with a USB-C cable plugged into the Nano ESP32.
Install the free Arduino Lab for MicroPython app on your computer.
Update the Alvik library and the carrier firmware together. Mismatched versions cause trouble.
Open the getting started guide on the Arduino docs site.
Run the first driving example and watch Alvik roll forward.
Try the line following lesson from the free Explore Robotics with MicroPython course.
meta: Open Code. From $112. A few stores.
